name: How long does it typically take to install a new lever style kitchen faucet?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to install a new lever style kitchen faucet?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation time for a lever style kitchen faucet can vary depending on several factors, including the complexity of the existing plumbing, whether modifications are needed to the sink or countertop, and if a new sink or garbage disposal is being installed simultaneously. On average, a straightforward replacement installation takes between 1 to 3 hours for a professional. More complex installations, such as those requiring new holes or significant adjustments, may take longer, up to half a day.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard lever style kitchen faucet installation typically takes a professional 1 to 3 hours, but can be longer for complex cases.
